title: Demo hr
keywords: Jspreadsheet, JavaScript data grid, spreadsheet controls, interactive data grid, web-based applications, lightweight, responsive controls, agnostic platform, Angular, React, Vue, spreadsheet-like plugin, documentation, examples, license
description: HR dashboard demo using JavaScript spreadsheet. Visualise workforce data and engagement metrics in a spreadsheet-style UI.

# HR Analytics Dashboard

HR analytics dashboard on a JavaScript spreadsheet interface. It includes visual summaries for employee distribution, engagement, or retention metrics—demonstrating how grid components can be tailored for workforce insights and people management tools.

<br>

        ],
        "bar": true,
        "toolbar": true,
        "fullscreen": false
    }
);
    return () => {
      instance?.destroy?.();
    };
  }, []);

  return <div ref={spreadsheetRef}></div>;
}
